title: Past Simple: правильные и неправильные глаголы

why: Past Simple рассказывает о действиях, которые произошли и закончились в прошлом: что вы делали вчера, на прошлой неделе, в 2020 году. В русском для этого есть простое прошедшее время (делал, пошёл), в английском — одна форма на все лица: I worked, she worked, they worked.
formation: • Утверждение: подлежащее + V2 (вторая форма глагола). I worked. He went.

• Правильные глаголы: V + -ed (work → worked, play → played). Если глагол оканчивается на -e, добавляем только -d (live → lived). Согласная + y → -ied (study → studied). Короткий глагол с ударной гласной + согласная удваивает её (stop → stopped).
• Неправильные глаголы нужно учить наизусть: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought, have → had, write → wrote, take → took, make → made.
• Отрицание: did not (didn't) + V1 (начальная форма). I didn't go. She didn't call.
• Вопрос: Did + подлежащее + V1? Did you see him? Where did you go?
• Глагол to be: was / were. I was tired. They were at home. Вопрос и отрицание без did: Was he late? We weren't there.
usage: 1. Законченное действие в прошлом с указанием времени. (I finished the task yesterday. — Я закончил задачу вчера.)
2. Последовательность действий в рассказе. (He opened the laptop, checked the code and fixed the bug. — Он открыл ноутбук, проверил код и исправил баг.)
3. Состояние или привычка в прошлом, которых уже нет. (We lived in Kyiv when I was a child. — Мы жили в Киеве, когда я был ребёнком.)
signalWords: yesterday, last week / month / year, two days ago, in 2019, when I was young, the other day, then, after that.
mistakes: • ✗ Did you went there? → ✓ Did you go there? После did глагол всегда в начальной форме.
• ✗ I didn't saw him. → ✓ I didn't see him. Прошедшее время уже выражено в did.
• ✗ He goed home. → ✓ He went home. Неправильные глаголы не берут -ed.
• ✗ She was go to work. → ✓ She went to work. Was/were не нужны с обычным глаголом.
• ✗ I studyed English. → ✓ I studied English. Согласная + y меняется на -ied.
remember: В вопросе и отрицании прошедшее время несёт did — а сам глагол возвращается в начальную форму.

items.prompt: I ___ (watch) a movie last night.
items.answer: watched

items.prompt: She ___ (go) to the gym yesterday.
items.answer: went

items.prompt: We ___ (play) football on Sunday.
items.answer: played

items.prompt: He ___ (buy) a new phone last week.
items.answer: bought

items.prompt: They ___ (study) for the exam two days ago.
items.answer: studied

items.prompt: I ___ (write) an email to the client this morning.
items.answer: wrote

items.prompt: The meeting ___ (start) at nine o'clock.
items.answer: started

items.prompt: My brother ___ (stop) the car near the bank.
items.answer: stopped

items.prompt: Did you (a) went (b) go to work yesterday?
items.answer: b (go)

items.prompt: She (a) didn't call (b) didn't called me.
items.answer: a (didn't call)

items.prompt: We (a) seen (b) saw a great film last Friday.
items.answer: b (saw)

items.prompt: He (a) was (b) were at home last night.
items.answer: a (was)

items.prompt: I (a) don't have (b) didn't have time yesterday.
items.answer: b (didn't have)

items.prompt: Where (a) did you buy (b) you bought this jacket?
items.answer: a (did you buy)

items.prompt: They (a) were (b) was very tired after the trip.
items.answer: a (were)

items.prompt: The team (a) finished (b) finish the project in May.
items.answer: a (finished)

items.prompt: I ate breakfast this morning.
items.answer: I didn't eat breakfast this morning.

items.prompt: She called her mother yesterday.
items.answer: She didn't call her mother yesterday.

items.prompt: We went to the cinema last night.
items.answer: We didn't go to the cinema last night.

items.prompt: He was late for the meeting.
items.answer: He wasn't late for the meeting.

items.prompt: They took a taxi to the airport.
items.answer: They didn't take a taxi to the airport.

items.prompt: You made a mistake in the code.
items.answer: You didn't make a mistake in the code.

items.prompt: The shop opened at eight.
items.answer: The shop didn't open at eight.

items.prompt: My parents were at home on Saturday.
items.answer: My parents weren't at home on Saturday.

exercises.instruction: Задайте вопрос к выделенной части (вопросительное слово дано в скобках)

items.prompt: She bought a laptop. (What)
items.answer: What did she buy?

items.prompt: They went to Poland last summer. (Where)
items.answer: Where did they go last summer?

items.prompt: He woke up at six. (What time)
items.answer: What time did he wake up?

items.prompt: We met Anna at the conference. (Who)
items.answer: Who did you meet at the conference? / Who did we meet at the conference?

items.prompt: I left the office early because I was sick. (Why)
items.answer: Why did you leave the office early?

items.prompt: The film lasted two hours. (How long)
items.answer: How long did the film last?

items.prompt: He came home by bus. (How)
items.answer: How did he come home?

items.prompt: You saw the manager yesterday. (Yes/no question)
items.answer: Did you see the manager yesterday?

items.prompt: Вчера я весь день работал дома.
items.answer: I worked at home all day yesterday.

items.prompt: Она не позвонила мне вчера вечером.
items.answer: She didn't call me last night.

items.prompt: Ты вчера видел новый дизайн?
items.answer: Did you see the new design yesterday?

items.prompt: Мы переехали в Киев в 2018 году.
items.answer: We moved to Kyiv in 2018.

items.prompt: Мой коллега исправил баг за час.
items.answer: My colleague fixed the bug in an hour.

items.prompt: Где ты купил этот рюкзак?
items.answer: Where did you buy this backpack?

items.prompt: Мы не поехали в отпуск в прошлом году.
items.answer: We didn't go on vacation last year.

items.prompt: Рейс был поздно, и мы приехали в отель в полночь.
items.answer: The flight was late, and we arrived at the hotel at midnight.
